description: **AISA — The Gold Standard in AI Fluency Measurement** AISA is the world's first conversational AI fluency assessment. Instead of quizzes or self-reported surveys, AISA measures real AI skill through a 30-minute adaptive conversation — assessing how people actually think about, use, and apply AI across 11 evidence-based criteria.
